snippet.title: Batman: Arkham Knight - Official Launch Trailer | PS4
snippet.description:
Be Vengeance. Be the Night. Be the Batman. 

Watch the extended launch video from Batman: Arkham Knight featuring “Mercy” from Muse’s new album “Drones”.

The epic finale to the Batman: Arkham series is available 06.23.15

Rated Mature: Blood, Language, Suggestive Themes, Violence
